title: REQ · Game config accepts and applies a zoom computed with computeZoom
summary: buildGameConfig and createGame take a zoom and put it in the Phaser config
description: Context: buildGameConfig(parent, scenes) in game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts builds the config without zoom, and createGame forwards only parent and scenes. Desired behavior: an optional zoom argument is forwarded and set as scale.zoom. Expected result: the Phaser game starts with the DPR-derived zoom. Why: initial render uses the correct pixel density.
acceptance_criteria: Given zoom 3, when buildGameConfig(parent, scenes, 3) is called, then config.scale.zoom equals 3
Given no zoom, when buildGameConfig(parent, scenes) is called, then config.scale.zoom equals 1
Given createGame(parent, scenes, 2), when it runs, then buildGameConfig receives zoom 2
definition_of_done: Config carries zoom and defaults to 1
